-- [ModuleScript] help
-- ReplicatedStorage.CmdrClient.Commands.help
-- 78 lines, 2.2 KB, decompiled in 0.00s
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
local v_u_1 = Color3.fromRGB(230, 126, 34)
local v_u_2 = Color3.fromRGB(230, 230, 230)
return {
	["Name"] = "help",
	["Aliases"] = nil,
	["Description"] = "Displays a list of all commands, or inspects one command.",
	["Group"] = "Help",
	["Args"] = nil,
	["ClientRun"] = nil,
	["Aliases"] = { "cmds", "commands" },
	["Args"] = {
		{
			["Type"] = "command",
			["Name"] = "Command",
			["Description"] = "The command to view information on.",
			["Optional"] = true
		}
	},
	["ClientRun"] = function(p3, p4) -- name: ClientRun
		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1, (copy) v_u_2
		local v5 = p3.Cmdr.Registry
		if p4 then
			local v6 = v5:GetCommand(p4)
			p3:Reply(("Command: %*"):format(v6.Name), v_u_1)
			if v6.Aliases and #v6.Aliases > 0 then
				p3:Reply(("Aliases: %*"):format((table.concat(v6.Aliases, ", "))), v_u_2)
			end
			if v6.Description then
				p3:Reply(("Description: %*"):format(v6.Description), v_u_2)
			end
			if v6.Group then
				p3:Reply(("Group: %*"):format(v6.Group), v_u_2)
			end
			if v6.Args then
				for v7, v8 in ipairs(v6.Args) do
					if type(v8) == "table" then
						local v9 = v8.Optional and "?" or ""
						p3:Reply((("#%* %*%*: %* - %*"):format(v7, v8.Name, v9, v8.Type, v8.Description)))
					else
						p3:Reply((("#%* Unknown (inline argument)"):format(v7)))
					end
				end
			end
		else
			p3:Reply("Argument Shorthands\n-------------------\n.   Me/Self\n*   All/Everyone\n**  Others\n?   Random\n?N  List of N random values\n")
			p3:Reply("Tips\n----\n\226\128\162 Use the Tab key to autocomplete commands and suggestions\n\226\128\162 Easily select and copy command output\n")
			local v10 = v5:GetCommands()
			table.sort(v10, function(p11, p12)
				if p11.Group and p12.Group then
					return p11.Group < p12.Group
				else
					return p11.Group ~= nil
				end
			end)
			local v13 = nil
			for _, v14 in ipairs(v10) do
				if v14._isHidden then
					continue
				end
				local v15 = v14.Group or "No Group"
				if v13 == v15 then
					v15 = v13
				else
					p3:Reply((("\n%*\n%*"):format(v15, (("-"):rep(#v15)))))
				end
				local v16
				if v14.Description then
					v16 = ("%* - %*"):format(v14.Name, v14.Description)
				else
					v16 = v14.Name
				end
				p3:Reply(v16)
				v13 = v15
			end
		end
		return ""
	end
}

local function v_u_127(p123) -- name: deepcopy
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_127
	local v124 = {}
	for v125, v126 in pairs(p123) do
		if type(v126) == "table" then
			v124[v125] = v_u_127(v126)
		else
			v124[v125] = v126
		end
	end
	return v124
end
function v_u_3.GetSkinsFromCase(p128) -- name: GetSkinsFromCase
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_3, (copy) v_u_127
	local v129 = {}
	for v130, v131 in pairs(v_u_3.WeaponSkins) do
		if v131.Case ~= p128 then
			continue
		end
		local v132 = {
			["Name"] = v130,
			["Rarity"] = v131.Rarity,
			["RarityInfo"] = v_u_3.Rarities[v131.Rarity]
		}
		table.insert(v129, v132)
	end
	table.sort(v129, function(p133, p134)
		return p133.RarityInfo.Weight > p134.RarityInfo.Weight
	end)
	local v135 = v_u_127(v_u_3.RarityPool)
	for v136, v137 in pairs(v135) do
		local v138 = false
		for _, v139 in pairs(v129) do
			if v139.Rarity ~= v137.name then
				continue
			end
			v138 = true
		end
		v135[v136].active = v138
	end
	return v129, v135
end
local function v_u_158(p140) -- name: baseSkinChances
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_3
	local v141 = v_u_3.GetSkinsFromCase(p140)
	local v142 = {}
	if #v141 == 0 then
		return v142, false
	end
	local v143 = 0
	local v144 = true
	for _, v145 in ipairs(v141) do
		local v146 = v_u_3.WeaponSkins[v145.Name]
		if v146 then
			v146 = v_u_3.WeaponSkins[v145.Name].Chance
		end
		local v147 = tonumber(v146)
		if not v147 then
			v144 = false
			break
		end
		v143 = v143 + v147
	end
	if v144 and v143 > 0 then
		for _, v148 in ipairs(v141) do
			local v149 = v148.Name
			local v150 = v_u_3.WeaponSkins[v148.Name].Chance
			v142[v149] = tonumber(v150) / v143
		end
		return v142, true
	end
	local _, v151 = v_u_3.GetSkinsFromCase(p140)
	local v152 = 0
	for _, v153 in ipairs(v151) do
		if v153.active == false then
			continue
		end
		v152 = v152 + v153.weight
	end
	if v152 <= 0 then
		return v142, false
	end
	local v154 = {}
	for _, v155 in ipairs(v141) do
		v154[v155.Rarity] = (v154[v155.Rarity] or 0) + 1
	end
	for _, v156 in ipairs(v151) do
		if v156.active == false or not v154[v156.name] then
			continue
		end
		for _, v157 in ipairs(v141) do
			if v157.Rarity ~= v156.name then
				continue
			end
			v142[v157.Name] = v156.weight / v152 / v154[v156.name]
		end
	end
	return v142, false
end
function v_u_3.GetSkinChances(p159, p160) -- name: GetSkinChances
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_158
	local v161, v162 = v_u_158(p159)
	if p160 and p160 > 1 then
		return require(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Modules.LuckMod).Chances(v161, p160), v162
	else
		return v161, v162
	end
end
function v_u_3.GetSkinChancePool(p163, p164) -- name: GetSkinChancePool
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_3
	local v165, v166 = v_u_3.GetSkinChances(p163, p164)
	if not v166 and (not p164 or p164 <= 1) then
		return nil
	end
	local v167 = {}
	for _, v168 in ipairs(v_u_3.GetSkinsFromCase(p163)) do
		local v169 = {
			["name"] = nil,
			["weight"] = nil,
			["active"] = true,
			["name"] = v168.Name,
			["weight"] = v165[v168.Name] or 0
		}
		table.insert(v167, v169)
	end
	return v167
end
function v_u_3.GetSkinsWithRarity(p170, p171) -- name: GetSkinsWithRarity
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_3
	local v172 = {}
	if p171 then
		for _, v173 in pairs(v_u_3.GetSkinsFromCase(p171)) do
			if v173.Rarity ~= p170 and v173.RarityInfo.Weight ~= p170 then
				continue
			end
			local v174 = v173.Name
			table.insert(v172, v174)
		end
		return v172
	else
		for v175, v176 in pairs(v_u_3.WeaponSkins) do
			if v176.Rarity ~= p170 and v_u_3.Rarities[v176.Rarity].Weight ~= p170 then
				continue
			end
			table.insert(v172, v175)
		end
		return v172
	end
end
function v_u_3.GetSkinsForWeapon(p177, p178) -- name: GetSkinsForWeapon
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_3
	if not p177 then
		return {}
	end
	local v179 = {}
	for v180, v181 in pairs(v_u_3.WeaponSkins) do
		if not table.find(v181.Weapons, p177) or p178 ~= nil and v181.Case ~= p178 then
			continue
		end
		table.insert(v179, v180)
	end
	return v179
end
function v_u_3.GetSkinForWeapon(p182, p183) -- name: GetSkinForWeapon
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_3
	if p182 then

			if not table.find(v185.Weapons, p182) or p183 ~= nil and v185.Case ~= p183 then
				continue
			end
			return v184
		end
	end
end
function v_u_3.GetWeaponsForCase(p186) -- name: GetWeaponsForCase

			table.insert(v188, v191)
		end
	end
	return v188
end

			continue

	end

function v_u_3.SkinCaseFull(p196, p197) -- name: SkinCaseFull
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_3
	local v198 = game:GetService("RunService"):IsClient() and _G.Data.WeaponSkins or _G.Profile:Get(p197, "WeaponSkins")
	for _, v199 in pairs(v_u_3.GetSkinsFromCase(p196)) do
		if v_u_3.CountOwned(v198, v199.Name) >= v_u_3.MaxItemStack then
			continue
		end
		return false
	end
	return true
end
function v_u_3.PlayerHasSkinCase(p200, p201) -- name: PlayerHasSkinCase
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_3
	if p200 then
		local v202 = game:GetService("RunService")
		local v203 = nil
		if v202:IsClient() then
			local _ = game.Players.LocalPlayer
			v203 = _G.Data.WeaponSkins
		elseif v202:IsServer() then

function v_u_406.Compose(...) -- name: Compose
	local v_u_412 = { ... }

		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_412
		for _, v414 in ipairs(v_u_412) do
			p413 = v414(p413)

	end
end
function v_u_406.Pipe(p415, ...) -- name: Pipe

		p415 = v416(p415)

end
function v_u_406.Curry(p_u_417) -- name: Curry
	return function(...)
		-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_417
		local v_u_418 = { ... }
		return #v_u_418 < 2 and function(...)
			-- upvalues: (ref) p_u_417, (copy) v_u_418
			return p_u_417(v_u_418[1], ...)
		end or p_u_417(...)
	end
end
function v_u_406.Partial(p_u_419, ...) -- name: Partial
	local v_u_420 = { ... }

		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_420, (copy) p_u_419
		local v421 = {}
		for _, v422 in ipairs(v_u_420) do
			table.insert(v421, v422)
		end

			table.insert(v421, v423)
		end
		return p_u_419(table.unpack(v421))
	end
end

function v_u_406.Sum(p465, p466) -- name: Sum
	local v467 = 0
	for v468, v470 in pairs(p465) do
		if p466 then
			local v470 = p466(v470, v468) or v470
		end
		if type(v470) ~= "number" then
			continue
		end
		v467 = v467 + v470
	end
	return v467
end
function v_u_406.Average(p471, p472) -- name: Average
	local v473 = 0
	local v474 = 0
	for v475, v477 in pairs(p471) do
		if p472 then
			local v477 = p472(v477, v475) or v477
		end
		if type(v477) ~= "number" then
			continue
		end
		v473 = v473 + v477
		v474 = v474 + 1
	end
	return v474 > 0 and v473 / v474 or 0
end
function v_u_406.Min(p478, p479) -- name: Min
	local v480 = (1 / 0)
	local v481 = nil
	for v482, v483 in pairs(p478) do
		local v484
		if p479 then
			v484 = p479(v483, v482) or v483
		else
			v484 = v483
		end
		if type(v484) ~= "number" or v484 >= v480 then
			continue
		end
		v481 = v483
		v480 = v484
	end
	return v481, v480
end
function v_u_406.Max(p485, p486) -- name: Max
	local v487 = (-1 / 0)

function v_u_15.getInstance(p_u_71, p_u_72) -- name: getInstance

	if v73 then
		return v73
	end
	local function v_u_77(p_u_74, p_u_75) -- name: cacheInstance
		-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_71
		if not p_u_71.cachedInstances[p_u_75] then

				-- upvalues: (ref) p_u_71, (copy) p_u_74, (copy) p_u_75
				p_u_71.cachedNamesToInstances[p_u_74] = nil
				p_u_71.cachedInstances[p_u_75] = nil
			end)
		end
	end
	local v78 = p_u_71.widget
	v_u_77("Widget", v78)
	if p_u_72 == "Widget" then
		return v78
	end
	local v_u_79 = nil
	local function v_u_85(p80) -- name: scanChildren
		-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_71, (ref) v_u_12, (copy) v_u_85, (copy) v_u_77, (copy) p_u_72, (ref) v_u_79

end

function v_u_15._updateSelectionInstances(p193) -- name: _updateSelectionInstances

	end
end

function v_u_15.bindEvent(p_u_201, p202, p_u_203) -- name: bindEvent
	local v204 = p_u_201[p202]
	local v205
	if v204 then
		if typeof(v204) == "table" then
			v205 = v204.Connect
		else
			v205 = false
		end
	else
		v205 = v204
	end
	assert(v205, "argument[1] must be a valid topbarplus icon event name!")
	local v206 = typeof(p_u_203) == "function"
	assert(v206, "argument[2] must be a function!")
	p_u_201.bindedEvents[p202] = v204:Connect(function(...)
		-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_203, (copy) p_u_201
		p_u_203(p_u_201, ...)
	end)
	return p_u_201
end
function v_u_15.unbindEvent(p207, p208) -- name: unbindEvent
	local v209 = p207.bindedEvents[p208]

function v_u_15.getInstance(p_u_75, p_u_76) -- name: getInstance
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_12
	local v77 = p_u_75.cachedNamesToInstances[p_u_76]
	if v77 then
		return v77
	end
	local function v_u_81(p_u_78, p_u_79) -- name: cacheInstance
		-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_75
		if not p_u_75.cachedInstances[p_u_79] then
			local v80 = p_u_79:GetAttribute("Collective")

				v80 = p_u_75.cachedCollectives[v80]

				-- upvalues: (ref) p_u_75, (copy) p_u_78, (copy) p_u_79
				p_u_75.cachedNamesToInstances[p_u_78] = nil
				p_u_75.cachedInstances[p_u_79] = nil
			end)
		end
	end
	local v82 = p_u_75.widget
	v_u_81("Widget", v82)
	if p_u_76 == "Widget" then
		return v82
	end
	local v_u_83 = nil
	local function v_u_89(p84) -- name: scanChildren
		-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_75, (ref) v_u_12, (copy) v_u_89, (copy) v_u_81, (copy) p_u_76, (ref) v_u_83
		for _, v85 in pairs(p84:GetChildren()) do

				continue
			end

			v_u_89(v87)

		end
	end

end

function v_u_15.convertLabelToNumberSpinner(p_u_272, p_u_273, p_u_274) -- name: convertLabelToNumberSpinner
	task.defer(function()
		-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_272, (copy) p_u_273, (copy) p_u_274
		local v_u_275 = p_u_272:getInstance("IconLabel")
		v_u_275.Transparency = 1
		p_u_273.Parent = v_u_275.Parent
		p_u_273.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
		p_u_273.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
		p_u_273.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0)
		p_u_273.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
		p_u_273.ClipsDescendants = false
		for _, v_u_276 in ipairs({
			"FontFace",
			"BorderSizePixel",
			"BorderColor3",
			"Rotation",
			"TextStrokeTransparency",
			"TextStrokeColor3",
			"TextStrokeTransparency",
			"TextColor3"
		}) do
			p_u_273[v_u_276] = v_u_275[v_u_276]
			p_u_272:addToJanitor(v_u_275:GetPropertyChangedSignal(v_u_276):Connect(function()
				-- upvalues: (ref) p_u_273, (copy) v_u_276, (copy) v_u_275
				p_u_273[v_u_276] = v_u_275[v_u_276]
			end))
		end
		local function v_u_281() -- name: getSpinnerSizeAndDigitCount
			-- upvalues: (ref) p_u_273
			local v277 = 0
			local v278 = 0
			for _, v279 in p_u_273.Frame:GetChildren() do
				local v280 = string.lower(v279.Name)
				if v280 == "digit" then
					v277 = v277 + v279.AbsoluteSize.X
					v278 = v278 + 1
				else
					if v280 ~= "prefix" and (v280 ~= "suffix" and v280 ~= "comma") or v279.Text == "" then
						continue
					end
					v277 = v277 + v279.AbsoluteSize.X
					v278 = v278 + 1
				end
			end
			return v277, v278
		end
		local function v_u_290() -- name: adjustSize
			-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_281, (ref) p_u_272, (ref) p_u_273, (copy) v_u_275
			local v282, v283 = v_u_281()
			if v283 < 18 then
				p_u_272:setLabel(p_u_273.Value)
			end
			local v284 = p_u_273.Frame.AbsoluteSize.X
			while v282 < v284 and p_u_272.isDestroyed ~= true do
				task.wait(0.05)
				if v283 > 0 and v283 < 8 then
					p_u_273.TextSize = v_u_275.TextSize
					break

function v_u_2.coinShower(p359, p360, p_u_361) -- name: coinShower

		end,
		["Spawn"] = function(p364, p365) -- name: Spawn

		end

local function v_u_118(p113) -- name: comboDps
	if not (p113 and (p113.M1Damages and p113.M1Times)) then
		return 0
	end
	local v114 = p113.M1ComboCooldown or 0
	local v115 = 0
	for _, v116 in ipairs(p113.M1Damages) do
		v115 = v115 + v116
	end
	for _, v117 in ipairs(p113.M1Times) do
		v114 = v114 + v117
	end
	return v114 > 0 and v115 / v114 or 0
end

					v131 = v131 + v132

			end

		local v136
		if v_u_112[v134] then
			v136 = v_u_112[v134]
		else
			if v135 then
				v135 = v135.M1Damages
			end

				end

			end

function v_u_111.BuildTakedownsInfo(p142) -- name: BuildTakedownsInfo
	local v143 = {
		["kills"] = {},
		["subs"] = {},
		["gamepass"] = {},
		["reward"] = {},
		["level"] = {},
		["streak"] = {}
	}
	local v144 = {}
	for v145, v146 in pairs(p142.constants.Takedowns) do
		local v147 = p142:DetermineItemType(v146)
		local v148 = v143[v147]
		table.insert(v148, p142:CreateInfoEntry(v145, v146, v147, "Takedowns"))
	end
	for v_u_149, v150 in pairs(v143) do
		if v_u_149 == "gamepass" or v_u_149 == "reward" then
			continue
		end
		table.sort(v150, function(p151, p152)
			-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_149
			local v153 = v_u_149 == "kills" and "Kills" or (v_u_149 == "subs" and "Subs" or (v_u_149 == "streak" and "Streak" or "Level"))
			return p151.data[v153] < p152.data[v153]
		end)
	end
	for _, v154 in ipairs({
		v143.level,
		v143.kills,
		v143.subs,
		v143.streak,
		v143.gamepass,
		v143.reward
	}) do
		for _, v155 in ipairs(v154) do
			table.insert(v144, v155)
		end
	end
	return v144
end
function v_u_111.BuildWeaponsInfo(p156) -- name: BuildWeaponsInfo

function v_u_111.UnregisterSpinViewport(p193, p194) -- name: UnregisterSpinViewport

			p193.spinConn = nil
		end
	end
end

function v_u_111.BuildPreviewWhileOnScreen(p_u_201, p_u_202, p_u_203) -- name: BuildPreviewWhileOnScreen
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_6, (copy) v_u_25, (ref) v_u_26
	local v204 = p_u_201.state.viewportBindings[p_u_202]
	if v204 then
		p_u_201.state.viewportBindings[p_u_202] = nil

	local v_u_205 = 0
	local v214 = v_u_6.bind(p_u_202, function(p206)
		-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_205, (copy) p_u_202, (copy) p_u_201, (ref) v_u_6, (copy) p_u_203, (ref) v_u_25, (ref) v_u_26

				-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_205, (copy) v_u_207, (ref) v_u_6, (ref) p_u_202, (ref) p_u_203, (copy) v_u_209, (ref) p_u_201

					v210 = v_u_6.isOn(p_u_202)

					-- upvalues: (ref) p_u_203, (ref) v_u_209, (ref) v_u_205, (ref) v_u_207, (ref) v_u_6, (ref) p_u_202, (ref) p_u_201

function v_u_111.StartSpin(p_u_218) -- name: StartSpin
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_6
	if not p_u_218.spinConn then
		p_u_218.spinConn = game:GetService("RunService").RenderStepped:Connect(function()
			-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_218, (ref) v_u_6
			local v219 = tick()
			for v220 = #p_u_218.spinViewports, 1, -1 do
				local v221 = p_u_218.spinViewports[v220]
				if v221.viewport.Parent and v221.viewport.CurrentCamera then
					if not v_u_6.isOn(v221.viewport) then
						continue
					end
					local v222 = v219 * 0.8
					local v223 = math.cos(v222) * v221.dist
					local v224 = v221.dist * 0.25
					local v225 = math.sin(v222) * v221.dist
					local v226 = Vector3.new(v223, v224, v225)
					v221.viewport.CurrentCamera.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(v221.center + v226, v221.center)
				else
					table.remove(p_u_218.spinViewports, v220)
				end
			end
		end)
	end
end
function v_u_111.RegisterSpinViewport(p227, p228, p229, p230) -- name: RegisterSpinViewport
	p227.spinViewports = p227.spinViewports or {}
	for v231 = #p227.spinViewports, 1, -1 do
		local v232 = p227.spinViewports[v231]
		if v232.viewport ~= p228 and v232.viewport.Parent then
			continue
		end
		table.remove(p227.spinViewports, v231)
	end
	local v233 = p227.spinViewports
	table.insert(v233, {
		["viewport"] = p228,
		["center"] = p229,
		["dist"] = p230
	})
	if p227.ui.frame.Visible then
		p227:StartSpin()
	end
end

function v_u_111.LoadShoeViewport(p_u_318, p319, p320, p321) -- name: LoadShoeViewport

				-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_323, (ref) v_u_322, (copy) v_u_324, (copy) p_u_318

							if not v327:IsA("BasePart") then
								continue

						end

						local v332 = v330.Y

	local v350 = _G.Data.EquippedShoe == v_u_348
	local v351 = (_G.Data.ShoeCashBuys or {})[v_u_348] or 0

	if v_u_347.Cash == nil then
		v352 = false

		v352 = v351 < (p_u_345.constants.ShoeCashLimit or 2)

function v_u_111.FormatNumber(_, p368) -- name: FormatNumber
	local v369 = math.floor(p368)
	local v370 = tostring(v369)
	repeat
		local v371
		v370, v371 = v370:gsub("^(-?%d+)(%d%d%d)", "%1,%2")
	until v371 == 0
	return v370
end
function v_u_111.HandleShoeAction(p372, p373) -- name: HandleShoeAction
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_15
	local v374 = p373.name
	if p372:ShoeOwnedCount(v374) == 0 then
		p372.state.requestDebounce = false
		p372:HandleShoeCashBuy()
		return
	elseif _G.Data.EquippedShoe == v374 then
		v_u_15.Fire("Shoes", "unequip")
	else
		v_u_15.Fire("Shoes", "equip", v374)
	end
end
function v_u_111.HandleShoeCashBuy(p_u_375) -- name: HandleShoeCashBuy
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_15
	if p_u_375.state.requestDebounce or p_u_375.state.currentCategory ~= "Shoes" then
		return
	else
		local v376 = p_u_375:GetSelectedItemInfo()
		local v377
		if v376 then
			local v378 = v376.data.Cash
			v377 = tonumber(v378)
		else
			v377 = v376
		end
		if v377 then
			if (_G.Data.Cash or 0) < v377 then
				p_u_375:ShowMessage("You can\'t afford this!", Color3.fromRGB(244, 204, 46))
			else
				p_u_375.state.requestDebounce = true
				v_u_15.Fire("Shoes", "buyCash", v376.name)
				task.delay(1, function()
					-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_375
					p_u_375.state.requestDebounce = false
					p_u_375:UpdatePreview(true)
				end)
			end
		else
			return
		end
	end
end
function v_u_111.HandleShoeRobux(p_u_379) -- name: HandleShoeRobux
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_15
	if p_u_379.state.requestDebounce or p_u_379.state.currentCategory ~= "Shoes" then
		return
	else
		local v380 = p_u_379:GetSelectedItemInfo()
		if v380 then
			p_u_379.state.requestDebounce = true
			v_u_15.Fire("Shoes", "buyRobux", v380.name)
			task.delay(1, function()
				-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_379
				p_u_379.state.requestDebounce = false
			end)
		end
	end
end

function v_u_111.HandleEmoteAction(p421, p422) -- name: HandleEmoteAction
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_15
	if p421:EmoteSlot(p422.name) then
		v_u_15.Fire("ChangeEmote", p422.name, nil)
	else
		for v423 = 1, 8 do
			if (_G.Data.EmoteWheel or {})[tostring(v423)] then
				continue
			end
			v_u_15.Fire("ChangeEmote", p422.name, v423)
			return
		end
		p421:ShowMessage("You already have " .. 8 .. " emotes equipped!", Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0))
	end
end

	p424.ui.equip.Visible = true
	p424.ui.equip.TextLabel.Text = p424:EmoteSlot(p425.name) and "Unequip" or "Equip"
end

function v_u_111.IsSkinCategory(p426, p427) -- name: IsSkinCategory
	local v428
	if p427 == nil or p426.skinTabByKey == nil then
		v428 = false
	else
		v428 = p426.skinTabByKey[p427] ~= nil
	end
	return v428
end
function v_u_111.SkinOwned(_, p429) -- name: SkinOwned
	local v430
	if _G.Data.WeaponSkins == nil then
		v430 = false
	else
		v430 = table.find(_G.Data.WeaponSkins, p429) ~= nil
	end
	return v430
end
function v_u_111.ResolveSkinForWeapon(p431, p432, _) -- name: ResolveSkinForWeapon
	local v433 = _G.Data.EquippedWeaponSkins
	local v434
	if type(v433) == "table" then
		v434 = v433[p432] or nil
	else
		v434 = nil
	end
	if v434 and p431:SkinOwned(v434) then
		local v435 = p431.constants.WeaponSkins[v434]
		if v435 and (v435.Weapons and table.find(v435.Weapons, p432)) then
			return v434
		else
			return nil
		end
	else
		return nil
	end
end
function v_u_111.BuildSkinsInfo(p_u_436, p437) -- name: BuildSkinsInfo
	local v438 = {}
	for v439, v440 in pairs(p_u_436.constants.WeaponSkins) do
		local v441 = false
		for _, v442 in ipairs(v440.Weapons) do
			if not table.find(p437.weapons, v442) then
				continue
			end
			v441 = true
		end
		if not v441 then
			break
		end
		local v443 = p437.key
		table.insert(v438, p_u_436:CreateInfoEntry(v439, v440, nil, v443))
	end
	table.sort(v438, function(p444, p445)
		-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_436
		local v446 = p_u_436.constants.Rarities[p444.data.Rarity].Weight
		local v447 = p_u_436.constants.Rarities[p445.data.Rarity].Weight
		if v446 == v447 then
			return p444.name < p445.name
		else
			return v447 < v446
		end
	end)
	return v438
end
function v_u_111.EnterSkinsMode(p448) -- name: EnterSkinsMode
	p448.ui.navigation.Visible = false
	p448.ui.skinNavigation.Visible = true
	p448:SelectSkinTab(p448.skinTabs[1].button)
end
function v_u_111.ExitSkinsMode(p449) -- name: ExitSkinsMode
	p449.ui.skinNavigation.Visible = false
	p449.ui.navigation.Visible = true
	if p449.ui.frame.Visible then
		p449:SelectNavigationCategory("Styles")
	else
		p449.state.currentCategory = "Styles"
		p449.state.selectedItem = _G.Data.Equipped
		p449.ui.scroller.CanvasPosition = Vector2.zero
		for _, v450 in ipairs(p449.ui.navigation:GetChildren()) do
			if not v450:IsA("ImageButton") or v450.Name == "Skins" then
				continue
			end
			v450.Image = p449.config.nonSelectedImageId
		end
		p449.ui.navigation.Styles.Image = p449.config.selectedImageId
	end
end
function v_u_111.SelectSkinTab(p451, p452) -- name: SelectSkinTab
	local v453 = p451.skinTabByButton[p452]
	if v453 then
		p451:ClearSearch()
		for _, v454 in pairs(p451.ui.skinNavigation:GetChildren()) do
			if not v454:IsA("ImageButton") or not p451.skinTabByButton[v454.Name] and v454.Name ~= "SHOES" then
				continue
			end
			v454.Image = p451.config.nonSelectedImageId
		end
		p451.ui.skinNavigation[p452].Image = p451.config.selectedImageId
		p451.categoryInfo[v453.key] = p451:BuildSkinsInfo(v453)
		if #p451.categoryInfo[v453.key] == 0 then
			p451.state.currentCategory = v453.key
			p451.state.selectedItem = nil
			p451:ClearScroller()
			p451.ui.equip.Visible = false
			if p451.ui.gift then
				p451.ui.gift.Visible = false
			end
			p451.ui.prices.Visible = false
			p451.ui.buyCash.Visible = false
			p451.ui.buyRobux.Visible = false
			p451.ui.preview.Visible = false
			p451.ui.requirements.Visible = false
			p451.ui.stats.Visible = false
			p451:ShowMessage("No skins for this weapon yet!", Color3.fromRGB(244, 204, 46))
		else
			p451.ui.preview.Visible = true
			p451:SetSelectedItem(v453.key, nil)
		end
	else
		return
	end
end
function v_u_111.UpdateSkinInfo(p455, p456) -- name: UpdateSkinInfo
	local v457 = p456.data
	local v458 = p455:SkinOwned(p456.name)
	local v459
	if v458 and v457.Weapons then
		v459 = false
		for _, v460 in ipairs(v457.Weapons) do
			if p455:ResolveSkinForWeapon(v460, v457.Case) ~= p456.name then
				continue
			end
			v459 = true
		end
	else
		v459 = v458
	end
	p455.ui.prices.Visible = false
	p455.ui.buyCash.Visible = false
	p455.ui.buyRobux.Visible = false
	p455.ui.equip.Visible = true
	p455.ui.requirements.Visible = true
	p455.ui.stats.Visible = true
	p455.ui.equip.TextLabel.Text = v459 and "Unequip" or (v458 and "Equip" or "Buy")
	p455:HideAllRequirements()
	p455.ui.requirements.SkinCase.Visible = true
	local v461 = p455.ui.requirements.SkinCase
	local v462 = string.format
	local v463 = p455.constants.SkinCases[v457.Case] and "%s CASE" or "%s BUNDLE"
	local v464 = v457.Case == "Walks" and "Movement" or v457.Case
	v461.Text = v462(v463, tostring(v464):upper())
	if v457.Reward then
		local v465 = p455.ui.requirements.SkinCase
		local v466 = v457.Reward
		v465.Text = tostring(v466):upper()
	end
	p455.ui.requirements.TextLabel.TextColor3 = v458 and Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255) or Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0)
	p455.ui.stats.DamageBoost.Visible = true
	if v457.WalkAnimations then
		local v467 = p455.constants.Rarities[v457.Rarity]
		local v468 = p455.ui.stats.DamageBoost
		local v469 = v457.Rarity
		v468.Text = "Rarity: " .. tostring(v469)
		p455.ui.stats.DamageBoost.TextColor3 = v467 and v467.Color or Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
	elseif v457.SpeedMultiplier then
		p455.ui.stats.DamageBoost.Text = string.format("+%.0f%% Speed", (v457.SpeedMultiplier - 1) * 100)
	else
		p455.ui.stats.DamageBoost.Text = string.format("+%.0f%% Damage", (v457.DamageMultiplier - 1) * 100)
	end
	p455.ui.stats.Special.Visible = false
	p455.ui.stats.ApplicableWeapons.Visible = false
	p455.ui.stats.SpeedBoost.Visible = false
end
function v_u_111.HasSkinWeapon(p470, p_u_471) -- name: HasSkinWeapon
	local function v474(p472) -- name: scan
		-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_471
		if not p472 then
			return false
		end
		for _, v473 in pairs(p472:GetChildren()) do
			if not (v473:IsA("Tool") and table.find(p_u_471, v473.Name)) then
				continue
			end
			return true
		end
		return false
	end
	return v474(p470.player.Character) or v474(p470.player:FindFirstChild("Backpack"))
end
function v_u_111.HandleSkinAction(p475, p476) -- name: HandleSkinAction
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_15
	if p475:SkinOwned(p476.name) then
		if p476.data.WalkAnimations or p475:HasSkinWeapon(p476.data.Weapons) then
			v_u_15.Fire("EquipSkinCase", p476.data.Case, p476.name)
		else
			p475:ShowMessage("You don\'t have a weapon this skin fits!", Color3.fromRGB(244, 204, 46))
		end
	elseif p475.constants.SkinCases[p476.data.Case] then
		_G.OpenSkinCaseSpins(p476.data.Case, true)
		return
	elseif p476.data.Reward then
		local v477 = p476.data.Reward
		p475:ShowMessage("Get this from the " .. tostring(v477) .. "!", Color3.fromRGB(244, 204, 46))
	else
		local v478 = p476.data.Case
		p475:ShowMessage("Get this from the " .. tostring(v478) .. " bundle in the Store!", Color3.fromRGB(244, 204, 46))
	end
end
function v_u_111.DetermineItemType(_, p479) -- name: DetermineItemType
	return p479.Gamepass and "gamepass" or (p479.Reward and "reward" or (p479.Subs and "subs" or (p479.Streak and "streak" or (p479.Kills and "kills" or "level"))))
end
function v_u_111.GetItemInfo(p480, p481, p482) -- name: GetItemInfo
	local v483 = p480.categoryInfo[p482 or p480.state.currentCategory]
	if not v483 then
		return nil
	end
	for _, v484 in pairs(v483) do
		if v484.name ~= p481 then
			continue
		end
		return v484
	end
	return nil
end
function v_u_111.GetSelectedItemInfo(p485) -- name: GetSelectedItemInfo
	return p485.state.selectedItem and p485:GetItemInfo(p485.state.selectedItem) or nil
end
function v_u_111.GetEquippedValueForCategory(_, p486) -- name: GetEquippedValueForCategory
	return _G.Data[({
		["Styles"] = "Equipped",
		["Takedowns"] = "EquippedTakedown",
		["Weapons"] = "EquippedWeapon",
		["Cameras"] = "EquippedCamera",
		["Vehicles"] = "EquippedVehicle",
		["Kill effects"] = "KillEffectEquipped",
		["Shoes"] = "EquippedShoe"
	})[p486]]
end
function v_u_111.SelectNavigationCategory(p487, p488) -- name: SelectNavigationCategory
	p487:ClearSearch()
	if p488 == "Skins" then
		p487:EnterSkinsMode()
	else
		if p488 == "Kill effects" then
			p487:RefreshKillEffects(false)
		elseif p488 == "Emotes" then
			p487:RefreshEmotes(false)
		end
		for _, v489 in pairs(p487.ui.navigation:GetChildren()) do
			if not v489:IsA("ImageButton") or v489.Name == "Skins" then
				continue
			end
			v489.Image = p487.config.nonSelectedImageId
		end
		p487.ui.navigation[p488].Image = p487.config.selectedImageId
		local v490 = p487:GetEquippedValueForCategory(p488)
		p487:LoadCategory(p488)
		p487:SetSelectedItem(p488, v490)
	end
end
function v_u_111.LoadCategory(p_u_491, p_u_492, p493) -- name: LoadCategory
	if p_u_491.state.loadDebounce then
		return
	else
		p_u_491.state.loadDebounce = true
		p_u_491.state.currentCategory = p_u_492
		local v_u_494
		if p493 then
			v_u_494 = p_u_491.state.savedScrollPosition or nil
		else
			v_u_494 = nil
		end
		if p_u_491.ui.getKillEffects then
			p_u_491.ui.getKillEffects.Visible = p_u_492 == "Kill effects"
		end
		if p_u_491.ui.getEmotes then
			p_u_491.ui.getEmotes.Visible = p_u_492 == "Emotes"
		end
		p_u_491:ClearScroller(p493)
		local v495 = p_u_491.categoryInfo[p_u_492]
		if v495 then
			for v496, v497 in ipairs(v495) do
				if p_u_492 == "Weapons" and (v497.data.Type and not p_u_491:OwnsPermWeapon(v497.name)) then
					continue
				end
				p_u_491:CreateLazyRow(p_u_492, v497, v496)
			end
			p_u_491:ApplyFilter()
			p_u_491.state.loadDebounce = false
			if p493 and v_u_494 then
				p_u_491.state.savedScrollPosition = nil
				task.defer(function()
					-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_491, (copy) p_u_492, (copy) v_u_494
					if p_u_491.ui.frame.Visible and p_u_491.state.currentCategory == p_u_492 then
						p_u_491.ui.scroller.CanvasPosition = v_u_494
					end
				end)
			end
		else
			p_u_491.state.loadDebounce = false
		end
	end
end
function v_u_111.ApplyFilter(p498) -- name: ApplyFilter
	local v499 = string.lower(p498.state.search or "")
	for _, v500 in ipairs(p498.state.shownButtons) do
		v500.Visible = v499 == "" and true or string.find(string.lower(v500:GetAttribute("DisplayName") or v500.Name), v499, 1, true) ~= nil
	end
	for v501 in pairs(p498.state.lazyRows) do
		v501.Visible = v499 == "" and true or string.find(string.lower(v501:GetAttribute("DisplayName") or v501.Name), v499, 1, true) ~= nil
	end
end
function v_u_111.ClearSearch(p502) -- name: ClearSearch
	p502.state.search = ""
	if p502.ui.search then
		p502.ui.search.Text = ""
	end
end
function v_u_111.CreateLazyRow(p_u_503, p_u_504, p_u_505, p_u_506) -- name: CreateLazyRow
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_6
	local v_u_507 = Instance.new("Frame")
	v_u_507.Name = p_u_505.name
	v_u_507:SetAttribute("DisplayName", p_u_505.data.DisplayName or p_u_505.name)
	v_u_507.Size = p_u_503.ui.template.Size
	v_u_507.LayoutOrder = p_u_506
	v_u_507.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	v_u_507.BorderSizePixel = 0
	v_u_507.Active = false
	local v508 = Instance.new("UIAspectRatioConstraint")
	v508.AspectRatio = 1
	v508.AspectType = Enum.AspectType.FitWithinMaxSize
	v508.DominantAxis = Enum.DominantAxis.Width
	v508.Parent = v_u_507
	local v_u_509 = {
		["category"] = p_u_504,
		["itemInfo"] = p_u_505
	}
	p_u_503.state.lazyRows[v_u_507] = v_u_509
	v_u_507.Parent = p_u_503.ui.scroller
	v_u_509.dispose = v_u_6.bind(v_u_507, function(p510)
		-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_503, (copy) v_u_507, (copy) v_u_509, (ref) v_u_6, (copy) p_u_504, (copy) p_u_505, (copy) p_u_506
		if p510 then
			task.defer(function()
				-- upvalues: (ref) p_u_503, (ref) v_u_507, (ref) v_u_509, (ref) v_u_6, (ref) p_u_504, (ref) p_u_505, (ref) p_u_506
				if p_u_503.state.lazyRows[v_u_507] == v_u_509 and (v_u_507.Parent and (v_u_507.Visible and v_u_6.isOn(v_u_507))) then
					v_u_509.dispose()
					p_u_503.state.lazyRows[v_u_507] = nil
					local v511 = p_u_503:CreateViewportButton(p_u_504, p_u_505)
					v511.LayoutOrder = p_u_506
					v511.Visible = true
					p_u_503:ShowButtonSelection(v511, p_u_505)
					v511.Parent = p_u_503.ui.scroller
					local v512 = p_u_503.state.shownButtons
					table.insert(v512, v511)
					v_u_507:Destroy()
				end
			end)
		end
	end)
	return v_u_507
end
function v_u_111.ClearScroller(p513, p514) -- name: ClearScroller
	if not p514 then
		p513.ui.scroller.CanvasPosition = Vector2.zero
	end
	for v515, v516 in pairs(p513.state.lazyRows) do
		if v516.dispose then
			v516.dispose()
		end
		v515:Destroy()
	end
	table.clear(p513.state.lazyRows)
	for _, v517 in pairs(p513.state.loadedButtons) do
		for _, v518 in pairs(v517) do
			v518:Destroy()
		end
	end
	table.clear(p513.state.loadedButtons)
	p513.state.shownButtons = {}
end
function v_u_111.CreateViewportButton(p519, p520, p521) -- name: CreateViewportButton
	local v522 = p519.state.loadedButtons[p520] or {}
	local v523 = v522[p521.name]
	local v524 = v523 ~= nil
	if not v524 then
		v523 = p519.ui.template:Clone()
		v522[p521.name] = v523
		p519.state.loadedButtons[p520] = v522
	end
	v523.TextLabel.Text = p521.data.DisplayName or p521.name
	v523:SetAttribute("DisplayName", p521.data.DisplayName or p521.name)
	v523.Name = p521.name
	if v523:FindFirstChild("Amount") then
		local v525 = p520 == "Emotes" and _G.Data.OwnedEmotes or p519:IsSkinCategory(p520) and _G.Data.WeaponSkins or (p520 == "Vehicles" and _G.Data.Vehicles or p520 == "Cameras" and _G.Data.Cameras or (p520 == "Shoes" and _G.Data.Shoes or nil))
		local v526 = v525 and (p519.constants.CountOwned(v525, p521.name) or 0) or 0
		v523.Amount.Text = "x" .. v526
		v523.Amount.Visible = v526 > 0
	end
	p519:ApplyExists(v523, p520, p521.name)
	p519:ApplySerial(v523, p520, p521.name)
	if v523:FindFirstChild("Reworked") then
		v523.Reworked.Visible = p521.data.Reworked == true
		local v527 = v523.New
		local v528
		if p521.data.IsNew == true then
			v528 = not p521.data.Reworked
		else
			v528 = false
		end
		v527.Visible = v528
	end
	if not v524 then
		p519:SetupButtonVisuals(v523, p520, p521)
		p519:SetupButtonEvents(v523, p520, p521)
	end
	return v523
end
function v_u_111.SetupButtonVisuals(p529, p530, p531, p532) -- name: SetupButtonVisuals
	if p532.data.WalkAnimations then
		local v533 = p529.constants.Rarities[p532.data.Rarity]
		p530.Image = p529.config.templateImageNoSaturation
		p530.ImageColor3 = v533 and v533.Color or Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
		p530.ImageLabel.Visible = false
		p529:LoadViewport(p530, p531, p532)
		return
	elseif p529:IsSkinCategory(p531) then
		if p530:FindFirstChild("Viewport") then
			p530.Viewport:Destroy()
		end
		p530.Image = p529.config.templateImageNoSaturation
		p530.ImageLabel.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
		p530.ImageLabel.Image = p532.data.Image or ""
		p530.ImageLabel.Rotation = p532.data.DisplayRotation or 0
		return
	elseif p531 == "Weapons" or p531 == "Kill effects" then
		if p530:FindFirstChild("Viewport") then
			p530.Viewport:Destroy()
		end
		p530.ImageLabel.Image = p532.data.Image or ""
		return
	elseif p531 == "Cameras" then
		p529:LoadCameraViewport(p530, p532)
		return
	elseif p531 == "Vehicles" then
		p529:LoadVehicleViewport(p530, p532)
		return
	elseif p531 == "Shoes" then
		p529:LoadShoeViewport(p530, p532)
		return
	elseif p531 == "Emotes" then
		p529:LoadEmoteViewport(p530, p532)
	else
		local v_u_534 = p529:LoadViewport(p530, p531, p532)
		p530.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
			-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_534
			if v_u_534 and v_u_534:FindFirstChild("PlayAnimation") then
				v_u_534.PlayAnimation:Fire()
			end
		end)
	end
end
function v_u_111.SetupButtonEvents(p_u_535, p536, p_u_537, p_u_538) -- name: SetupButtonEvents
	p536.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
		-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_535, (copy) p_u_538, (copy) p_u_537
		p_u_535.state.selectedItem = p_u_538.name
		local v539 = p_u_535.state.loadedButtons[p_u_537] or {}
		for v540, v541 in pairs(v539) do
			p_u_535:ShowButtonSelection(v541, p_u_535:GetItemInfo(v540, p_u_537))
		end
		p_u_535:UpdatePreview(false, p_u_537, p_u_538)
	end)
	_G.AntHoverSize(p536)
end
function v_u_111.LoadViewport(p_u_542, p_u_543, p_u_544, p_u_545, p546) -- name: LoadViewport
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_24
	local v_u_547 = p546 or p_u_543:WaitForChild("Viewport")
	local v_u_548 = v_u_547:WaitForChild("WorldModel")
	p_u_542:BuildPreviewWhileOnScreen(v_u_547, function(p549)
		-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_24, (copy) v_u_548, (ref) v_u_547, (copy) p_u_543, (copy) p_u_545, (copy) p_u_542, (copy) p_u_544
		local v550 = game.StarterPlayer:WaitForChild("StarterCharacter")
		if p549() then
			local v551 = (v_u_24 or v550):Clone()
			local v552 = v551:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
			if p549() then
				v551.Parent = v_u_548
				local v553 = v_u_547.CurrentCamera or Instance.new("Camera", v_u_548)
				local v554 = v551:GetPivot()
				local v555
				if p_u_543.Name:match("Preview") then
					v555 = p_u_545.category == "Styles" and 5 or 6
				else
					v555 = p_u_545.category == "Styles" and 6.2 or 6.8
				end
				v553.CFrame = CFrame.new(v554.Position + v554.LookVector * v555 + Vector3.new(0, -0.465, 0), v554.Position + Vector3.new(0, -0.465, 0))
				v_u_547.CurrentCamera = v553
				p_u_542:SetupCharacterAnimations(v551, v552, p_u_544, p_u_545, v_u_547, p549)
			else
				v551:Destroy()
			end
		else
			return
		end
	end)
	return v_u_547
end
function v_u_111.SetupCharacterAnimations(p556, p_u_557, p_u_558, p559, p560, p561, p_u_562) -- name: SetupCharacterAnimations
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_23, (ref) v_u_24, (copy) v_u_14, (copy) v_u_3
	if not p_u_557:GetAttribute("AvatarApplied") then
		local function v564()
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_23, (copy) p_u_562, (copy) p_u_558, (copy) p_u_557, (ref) v_u_24
			local v563 = v_u_23()
			if p_u_562() and v563 then
				p_u_558:ApplyDescription(v563)
				p_u_557:SetAttribute("AvatarApplied", true)
				if not v_u_24 then
					v_u_24 = p_u_557:Clone()
				end
			end
		end
		pcall(v564)
	end
	if p_u_562() then
		local v565 = p_u_558:WaitForChild("Animator", 5)
		if p_u_562() and v565 then
			if p560.data.WalkAnimations then
				local v566 = Instance.new("Animation")
				v566.AnimationId = "rbxassetid://" .. p560.data.WalkAnimations.Run
				local v567 = v565:LoadAnimation(v566)
				v566:Destroy()
				v567.Looped = true
				v567.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Action
				v_u_14(p561, v567)
				return
			else
				local v568 = v_u_3.Animations:FindFirstChild(p559)
				if v568 then
					v568 = v568:FindFirstChild(p560.name)
				end
				if v568 then
					local v569 = v568:FindFirstChild(p559 == "Styles" and "Idle" or "Doer")
					if v569 then
						local v570 = v565:LoadAnimation(v569)
						v570.Looped = true
						v570.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Action
						v_u_14(p561, v570)
						if p559 == "Styles" then
							p556:SetupStyleAnimations(v565, v568, p560, p561)
						end
					end
				end
			end
		else
			return
		end
	else
		return
	end
end
function v_u_111.SetupStyleAccessories(p571, p572, p573) -- name: SetupStyleAccessories
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_3
	if p571.framework.infos[p573.name] then
		local v574 = v_u_3.StyleAccessories:FindFirstChild(p573.name)
		if v574 then
			for _, v575 in pairs(v574:GetChildren()) do
				if not (v575:IsA("Accessory") or v575:IsA("Accoutrement")) then
					continue
				end
				v575:Clone().Parent = p572
			end
		end
	else
		return
	end
end
function v_u_111.SetupStyleAnimations(p576, p577, p578, p579, p_u_580) -- name: SetupStyleAnimations
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_6
	local v581 = p576.framework.infos[p579.name]
	if v581 then
		local v582 = p576.state.styleAnimationBindings[p_u_580]
		if v582 then
			v582.token = v582.token + 1
			if v582.connection then
				v582.connection:Disconnect()
			end
			for _, v_u_583 in ipairs(v582.tracks) do
				pcall(function()
					-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_583
					v_u_583.track:Stop()
					v_u_583.track:Destroy()
				end)
			end
		end
		local v_u_584 = {
			["tracks"] = nil,
			["token"] = 0,
			["isPlayingCombo"] = false,
			["tracks"] = {}
		}
		for v585, v586 in ipairs(v581.M1Times) do
			local v587 = p577:LoadAnimation(p578:FindFirstChild("M1-" .. v585))
			if not v587 then
				continue
			end
			v587.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Action2
			local v588 = v_u_584.tracks
			table.insert(v588, {
				["duration"] = v586,
				["track"] = v587
			})
		end
		local function v592()
			-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_584, (copy) p_u_580, (ref) v_u_6
			v_u_584.connection = p_u_580.PlayAnimation.Event:Connect(function()
				-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_584, (ref) v_u_6, (ref) p_u_580
				if not v_u_584.isPlayingCombo then
					v_u_584.isPlayingCombo = true
					local v_u_589 = v_u_584.token
					task.spawn(function()
						-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_584, (copy) v_u_589, (ref) v_u_6, (ref) p_u_580
						task.wait(0.5)
						local v590 = nil
						for _, v591 in ipairs(v_u_584.tracks) do
							if v_u_584.token ~= v_u_589 or not v_u_6.isOn(p_u_580) then
								break
							end
							if v590 then
								v590:Stop()
							end
							v590 = v591.track
							v590:Play()
							task.wait(v591.duration)
						end
						if v_u_584.token == v_u_589 then
							v_u_584.isPlayingCombo = false
						end
					end)
				end
			end)
		end
		pcall(v592)
		p576.state.styleAnimationBindings[p_u_580] = v_u_584
	end
end
function v_u_111.ShowButtonSelection(p593, p594, p595) -- name: ShowButtonSelection
	if p595 then

			p594.ImageColor3 = v600 and Color3.fromRGB(77, 255, 0) or (v602 and v602.Color or Color3.fromRGB(255, 234, 0))

		elseif p595.category == "Kill effects" then

			p594.TextLabel.TextColor3 = v603 and Color3.fromRGB(77, 255, 0) or Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
			p594.ImageColor3 = v603 and Color3.fromRGB(77, 255, 0) or Color3.fromRGB(255, 234, 0)
			return
		elseif p595.category == "Emotes" then
			local v604 = p593:EmoteSlot(p595.name) ~= nil
			p594.TextLabel.TextColor3 = v604 and Color3.fromRGB(77, 255, 0) or Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
			p594.ImageColor3 = v604 and Color3.fromRGB(77, 255, 0) or Color3.fromRGB(255, 234, 0)
		else
			local v605 = p593:GetEquippedValueForCategory(p595.category) == p595.name
			local v606 = v605 or p593.state.selectedItem == p595.name
			p594.TextLabel.TextColor3 = v605 and Color3.fromRGB(77, 255, 0) or (v606 and Color3.fromRGB(255, 234, 0) or Color3.new(1, 1, 1))
			p594.ImageColor3 = v605 and Color3.fromRGB(77, 255, 0) or Color3.fromRGB(255, 234, 0)
		end
	else
		return
	end
end

function v_u_111.UpdatePreviewInfo(p624, p625, p626) -- name: UpdatePreviewInfo
	if p624.ui.gift then
		p624.ui.gift.Visible = p626 == "Cameras" and true or p626 == "Vehicles"
	end
	p624:HideShoeUI()
	if p626 == "Shoes" then
		p624:UpdateShoeInfo(p625)
		return
	elseif p624:IsSkinCategory(p626) then
		p624:UpdateSkinInfo(p625)
		return
	elseif p626 == "Weapons" then
		p624:UpdateWeaponInfo(p625)
		return
	elseif p626 == "Cameras" then
		p624:UpdateCameraInfo(p625)
		return
	elseif p626 == "Vehicles" then
		p624:UpdateVehicleInfo(p625)
		return
	elseif p626 == "Kill effects" then
		p624:UpdateKillEffectInfo(p625)
		return
	elseif p626 == "Emotes" then
		p624:UpdateEmoteInfo(p625)
	else
		p624:UpdateEquippableInfo(p625, p626)
	end
end
function v_u_111.OwnsPermWeapon(p627, p628) -- name: OwnsPermWeapon
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_18, (copy) v_u_19
	if not v_u_18 then
		return false
	end
	local v629 = _G.Data.PermanentTools
	if type(v629) == "table" and v629[p628] == true then
		return true
	end
	local v630 = v_u_19[p628]
	local v631
	if v630 == nil then
		v631 = false
	else
		v631 = p627.framework:OwnsGamepass(v630) == true
	end
	return v631
end
function v_u_111.UpdateWeaponInfo(p632, p633) -- name: UpdateWeaponInfo
	p632.ui.equip.Visible = false
	p632.ui.requirements.Visible = false
	p632.ui.stats.Visible = false
	if p632:OwnsPermWeapon(p633.name) then
		p632.ui.buyCash.Visible = false
		p632.ui.buyRobux.Visible = false
		p632.ui.prices.Visible = false
		p632.ui.equip.Visible = true
		local v634 = _G.Data.HiddenPermTools
		local v635
		if type(v634) == "table" then
			v635 = v634[p633.name] == true
		else
			v635 = false
		end
		p632.ui.equip.TextLabel.Text = v635 and "Equip" or "Unequip"
		return
	else
		local v636 = _G.Data.EquippedWeapon == p633.name
		p632.ui.buyCash.Visible = not v636
		p632.ui.buyRobux.Visible = true
		p632.ui.buyRobux.ImageColor3 = _G.Data.AutoBuyWeapon == p633.name and Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255) or Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0)
		if p633.type and p633.type:len() ~= 0 then
			p632.ui.prices.Visible = false
		else
			p632.ui.prices.Visible = true
			local v637 = _G.Data.Cash
			local v638 = p633.data.Cash
			local v639 = tonumber(v638) <= v637
			p632.ui.prices.Cash.Text = string.format("<font color=\"#%s\">$%s</font>", v639 and "64DD37" or "FF0000", p632.framework.abbComma(p633.data.Cash))
		end
	end
end
function v_u_111.UpdateEquippableInfo(p640, p641, p642) -- name: UpdateEquippableInfo
	p640.ui.buyCash.Visible = false
	p640.ui.buyRobux.Visible = false

	end
end
function v_u_111.UpdateGamepassInfo(p643, p644, p645) -- name: UpdateGamepassInfo

		v647 = v646
	end
	p643:HideAllRequirements()
	p643.ui.requirements.Gamepass.Visible = true
	p643.ui.requirements.Gamepass.TextColor3 = Color3.fromHex(v646 and "64DD37" or "FF0000")
	p643.ui.equip.TextLabel.Text = v647 and "Equipped" or (v646 and "Equip" or "Buy Gamepass")
	p643.ui.requirements.TextLabel.TextColor3 = v646 and Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255) or Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0)
	p643:UpdateStatsInfo(p644, p645)
end

function v_u_111.UpdateStandardInfo(p653, p654, p655) -- name: UpdateStandardInfo
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1
	p654.data = v_u_1.StyleInfo(p654.name, p654.data, game.Players.LocalPlayer)
	local v656 = p654.type == "subs" and "Subs" or (p654.type == "kills" and "Kills" or (p654.type == "streak" and "Streak" or "Level"))
	local v657 = p653:CheckBaseRequirement(p654, v656)
	local v658 = p654.data.Cash ~= nil
	local v659 = not v658
	if not v659 then
		local v660 = _G.Data.Cash
		local v661 = p654.data.Cash
		v659 = tonumber(v661) <= v660
	end
	local v662 = v657 and v659
	local v663 = table.find(_G.Data[p654.category], p654.name)
	local v664
	if v663 then
		v664 = _G.Data[p655 == "Takedowns" and "EquippedTakedown" or "Equipped"] == p654.name
	else
		v664 = v663
	end
	p653.ui.equip.TextLabel.Text = v664 and "Equipped" or (v663 and "Equip" or (v662 and "Buy" or "LOCKED"))
	p653:HideAllRequirements()
	p653.ui.requirements[v656].Visible = true
	p653.ui.requirements.Cash.Visible = v658
	if v658 then
		p653.ui.requirements.Cash.Text = string.format("<font color=\"#%s\">$%s</font>", v659 and "64DD37" or "FF0000", p653.framework.abbComma(p654.data.Cash))
	end
	local v665 = v656 == "Level" and string.format("level %s", p653.framework.abbComma(p654.data[v656])) or string.format("%s %s", p653.framework.abbComma(p654.data[v656]), v656:lower())
	p653.ui.requirements[v656].Text = string.format("%s <font color=\"#%s\">(%s)</font>", v665, v657 and "64DD37" or "FF0000", p653.framework.abbComma(_G.Data[v656]))
	p653.ui.requirements.TextLabel.TextColor3 = v662 and Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255) or Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0)
	p653:UpdateStatsInfo(p654, p655)
end
function v_u_111.UpdateStatsInfo(p666, p667, p668) -- name: UpdateStatsInfo

	local v149 = os.time() - (tonumber(p148) or 0)

		return "TRADED JUST NOW"
	end

	if v150 < 3600 then
		local v153 = v150 / 60
		v151 = math.floor(v153)
		v152 = "MINUTE"
	elseif v150 < 86400 then
		local v154 = v150 / 3600
		v151 = math.floor(v154)
		v152 = "HOUR"
	else

		v152 = "DAY"
	end
	return ("TRADED %d %s%s AGO"):format(v151, v152, v151 == 1 and "" or "S")
end
